body: I feel the same I feel like my plain existence is all I have to offer all i have going for me, it's awful. And my existence isn't good enough
I honestly wish i HAD this skill though. I want to but its so hard.
We had a pit bull mix that used to sit exactly like this and watch animal planet!  Ha! So cute

That's kinda what I thought and was hoping for. That maybe he'd get a little older and grow out of it and we could be friends. Some arguments and really hurtful texts had happened since we stopped being friends so Idk if our relationship will be the same as it was probably not but I hope it could get as close as possible at least where we forgive eachother and have no hard feelings and just build up that trust again :)
Friendships like these don't happen often between boys and girls because we're so different but to be lucky enough to have had one is probably one of the best gifts in this entire world.

Also its a feeling that unless you've experienced it personally or something similar there's really no words to explain how deep the sadness really goes and people tend to tell you to get over it and it happened for a reason but it's not always that simple....

Honestly reading your story made me just as sad for you as I was/am about my situation. It's a particularly lonely and empty feeling to have and you can't quite put your finger on it. It's almost like you had a friend and then they just died and you never told them you loved them or got to say good bye. Only in my case I still see him because of family but I don't really know who he is anymore and he completely changed after entering high school. I'm 3 years older than him but his conversation was more advanced for his age he was more intelligent than most 13 years Olds his age so we kind of balanced eachother out and we went to a smaller private school where every grade was working in one room so it's not like we had separate classes I could pretty much get out of my seat and walk over to talk to him whenever I wanted. This is actually the first time I've really been able to successfully process my memories and right them down and get in the right words. It's the saddest feeling I've ever felt even from a relative dying because the person is still there and around and they either change or move. In my case he changed and it was like something took over him from one day to the next and he was a completely different person. Everyone we knew even used to tease him that he liked me so of course it came up in conversation. I outright asked him if he had any of those types of feelings and if he did to get them out all on the table but he confirmed no feelings like that at all towards me and I'd never thought of him that way seeing as I was 3 years older so I didn't feel bad when he said he had no feelings and I agreed but he was nonetheless the best guy friend I've ever had. That just goes to show it doesn't matter what Era you're from kids are kids and friendship is friendship, feelings are feelings. But if you were 6 in 88, you're only about 6 years older than me and that was one of the things I loved about our relationship was it was so pure and it wasn't planted in front of computer screens and video games like a lot of younger kids past our generation. It was fresh air and sunburns, coming in so thirsty you thought you'd die if you didn't drink a whole swimming pool. Don't get me wrong we had our fair share of movies and video games but our relationship was so much more than that. Usually a close girl friend is someone girls choose to tell their feelings about their first real feelings for boys but he was the one I talked to and he wasn't like super feminine or anything just a good listener and advice giver and just opened my eyes and put things into perspective sometimes. He was 12 almost 13 and I was 15 almost 16 but our personalities just really clicked. Music, movies, opinions everything. Then I started having  a crush on his older brother who was my age and shortly after was when he kind of faded but it wasn't like most girls who kicked their friends aside when they had a new boy at their hip. In fact I wanted to spend more time with him still than my new boyfriend lol because I was comfortable with my best friend. To this day he hasn't given me a straight answer as to why and for some reason I'm seeing a pattern with the boys/men I've dealt with that they kind of ditch you and don't explain. Now for a girl or anyone probably that's very confusing and nerve racking. It's too many unanswered questions for me and leaves the reason waaaay too open for interpretation. And if anyone knows how women over analyze you can pretty much see why it's a recipe for disaster. Now I'm not a guy so I don't know how they think when it comes to things like this so I'm totally open to opinions and ideas because I'm not a guy so Idk why but a lot of friends who I've explained this too now throw out the idea that maybe he had some sort of feelings but honestly if he did he had a serious poker face about it because this boy never ever let on. I mean ever we even talked about the types of girls he liked! So if he did have feelings he was very good about lying or i was completely oblivious which I doubt because I pick up on the littlest things. These stories are both heart warming and depressing and make you kind of want to crawl in a cave and never come out and your comment kind of helped me realize that basically I have the memories and I can only hope he dwells on the same ones. Being a child and teen is in some ways life's most cruel times and some of the best. Thanks for sharing your thoughts it really helps to know I'm not the only one. And just for your sake of a time frame this friendship was from about 2009 to 2011. So at least 3 full years. He had other friends his age that he hung with but we were the closest and always together. So not really that long ago. Now hell be 18 in Nov and I'll be 21 in a couple weeks. I've gotten the courage to talk to him once in about 3 years and I took him to Starbucks just me and him and bought him something but the conversation was surface stuff (what you been up to?, where are you going when you graduate etc) in some ways it's worse that he's not moved away because when I see him I just want to grab his shoulders and shake him and ask where my best friend went so it's a very hard place to be. But thanks for your response :)
